clips.ka_iso_halvempi: The big bag is cheaper. The more you buy at once, the cheaper it gets.
clips.ka_vihje_kolikot: Count the coins. The cheapest has the fewest coins.
clips.ka_vihje_kerro: Work out what all the bags cost together. For example two bags at four euros cost eight euros.
clips.ka_mika_hinta: Which price brings the most money?
clips.ka_halpa_kannatti: This time the low price paid off, because lots of buyers came.
clips.ka_kallis_kannatti: The high price paid off, even though fewer buyers came. Each cookie brought more.
clips.ka_keski_kannatti: The best price was not too cheap and not too dear.
clips.ka_vihje_pino: Look at the piles of coins. Where are the most coins?
clips.ka_vihje_hinta: Every buyer pays the price. Count the buyers times the price.
clips.ka_vihje_loppuu: Remember that the cookies can run out. Then the other buyers get nothing.
clips.ka_montako_mainosta: How many adverts are worth buying?
clips.ka_mainos_kannattaa: The advert brought more buyers, and more money was left.
clips.ka_mainos_ei_kannata: This time the advert didn't pay off. It cost more than it brought.
clips.ka_vihje_mainos: The yellow coins come from buyers. The red coins pay for adverts. Where is the most left?
clips.ka_vihje_mainos_laske: Every new buyer brings the price in money. Is an advert worth it if it brings less than it costs?
clips.ka_oma_alku: Now you have your own cookie shop and ten euros.
clips.ka_ohje: Buy cookies, choose the price and the adverts, and open the shop with the green button.
clips.ka_ei_enempaa: There is no room for more adverts.
clips.ka_nain_moni: This many will come to buy:
clips.ka_osta_ensin: Buy some cookies first. In the big bag one cookie is the cheapest.
clips.ka_nolla: No money came in or went out.
clips.ka_loppui: The cookies ran out and some buyers left with nothing. Buy more cookies.
clips.ka_kallis: The price was high, so only a few came. An advert brings more buyers.
clips.ka_halpa: The low price brought many buyers, but each cookie left little money.
clips.ka_jai: The cookies left over keep until tomorrow.
clips.ka_tavoite_ok: Hooray! You saved enough for the bike!
clips.ka_tavoite_ei: Not enough for the bike yet. Try again!
clips.ka_vihje_kauppa: Don't sell too cheap or too dear. See how many buyers wait on the street, and buy that many cookies. Adverts bring more buyers.
